pages.text: Carries redstone $(l)without any loss$() over any distance. Wires stick to surfaces: click a floor, wall or ceiling. They connect straight, around inner corners (several faces in one block) and around outer corners over a block edge.
Breaking a block with several wires removes the one you aim at. Only one wire type or colour can share a block space. Wires strongly power the block they lie on, like a repeater.
